title: Prophylactic cranial irradiation versus active MRI surveillance for limited-stage small-cell lung cancer achieving response after chemoradiotherapy: a protocol for a randomized, controlled, multicenter, phase III trial.
snippet: Prophylactic cranial irradiation (PCI) is the standard preventive strategy for limited-stage small-cell lung cancer (LS-SCLC). However, the evidence supporting this strategy is largely based on the pre-MRI era.
